contentHtml:
Agents are burning tokens you cannot attribute. One Cursor session, three models, two retries, an escalation you never asked for — and the invoice is still one line item with no project name on it.

We open-sourced ModelSpend for that.

Landing: /modelspend · Repo: github.com/rmencke2/modelspend · Release: v0.3.0b1

Two jobs

  1. Know where the money goes. Tag any call with project, agent, optional run_id, and up to eight labels — SDK args, CLI flags, env, or OpenAI-compatible headers (X-ModelSpend-Project, -Agent, -Run, -Labels). Report tokens by type (input, cached, output, reasoning), cost, and overhead from failed calls, retries, and escalations. Pin a model if you only want measurement.
  2. Spend less. Route each task to the lowest-cost model expected to fit, inside a USD or token budget. Hard budgets refuse before the provider call (HTTP 429). Soft budgets only warn.

Your keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and xAI. No prompts stored. Apache-2.0. Local OpenAI-compatible server — point the agent at model="auto".

Why this sits next to Influzer

Influzer is the MCP directory: search, handshake, paste, allowlist. That stack answers which tool server the agent may call.

ModelSpend answers the next bill: which model paid for the reasoning, under which project, and whether the next call is allowed to leave the machine. Same team. Different socket. Both refuse to pretend a demo is a control plane.

Drop it in front of any OpenAI client

from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1", api_key="unused-unless-token-set")
r = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="auto",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Classify: refund me as billing|bug|other"}],
    extra_body={
        "modelspend": {
            "providers": ["anthropic", "openai"],
            "max_budget_usd": 0.01,
            "profile": "economy",
        }
    },
)
print(r.choices[0].message.content, r.model_extra["modelspend"]["explanation"])

Tag from the CLI the same way:

modelspend route "Classify: I was charged twice" \
  --providers anthropic --project billing --agent invoice-bot
modelspend report --by project,agent,model --since 7d
modelspend budget set --project shop --period monthly --usd 50

Five minutes with no keys

Clone, install editable, print the policy, preview on the synthetic catalog (no call, no spend):

git clone https://github.com/rmencke2/modelspend.git
cd modelspend
python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install -e .
modelspend policy
modelspend preview "Classify this ticket" --catalog synthetic --assume-keys

Full setup, pricing sync, and limitations live in the repo README and on /modelspend.

Honest status (beta)

ModelSpend does not guarantee the cheapest successful model. “Suitable” is an estimate from catalog tier priors and, as you run evaluations, measured evidence.

  • Only Anthropic prices ship until you sync other providers’ catalogs. Tokens are always exact (provider-reported). Cost is unknown when a model has no price.
  • Verified live on Anthropic and (partially) OpenAI for routing, token counts, and budgets. Gemini and xAI adapters are implemented; live reports welcome.
  • Only calls that go through ModelSpend are counted. Traffic that bypasses it is invisible — which is the point of putting it in the path.

We would rather ship that disclaimer than a fake “always cheapest” badge.

Quick answers

Do I have to route to use it?

No. Pin a model (--model provider/id or a non-auto model on the server) and ModelSpend only measures.

Where do budgets apply?

Before every provider call — including retries, failovers, escalations, classifier/judge calls, and streams. Hard = refuse with 429. Soft = warn.

Is this an MCP server?

No. It is a local cost router and usage ledger in front of LLM providers. Influzer MCP Discovery stays the read-only catalog search path.

Windows / Gemini / xAI?

Open an issue. That feedback is the product right now.

Final thought

Directories tell you which tool server to allowlist. ModelSpend tells you which model paid for the turn — and whether the next turn is allowed to leave.

Tag the project. Cap the budget. Route model="auto". Star the repo if agents should know their bill.

Start at /modelspend. Clone github.com/rmencke2/modelspend. Keep writes — and spend — on a list you can name.
